description: This file defines classes and types for handling API requests and responses within the Playwright testing framework, including request creation, fetch options, response parsing, and file handling.

classes.name: APIRequest
classes.description: Handles creation of new request contexts and manages multiple API request sessions.

classes.name: APIRequestContext
classes.description: Represents a specific API request context, allowing for request execution, response handling, and storage state management.

classes.name: APIResponse
classes.description: Encapsulates the response from an API request, providing methods to access status, headers, body, and JSON content.

methods.name: newContext
methods.description: Creates a new API request context with specified options.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the request context, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Sends a DELETE request to the specified URL.

methods.name: head
methods.description: Sends a HEAD request to the specified URL.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Sends a PATCH request to the specified URL.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Sends a POST request to the specified URL.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Sends a PUT request to the specified URL.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Performs a fetch request with specified options.

methods.name: _innerFetch
methods.description: Internal method to handle the fetch logic, including request setup and response parsing.

methods.name: storageState
methods.description: Retrieves or saves the storage state for the request context.
